column1: # "Run for it" stations: the listed cantons count as visited if you spend at least
# <minutes> at this station, because you can run across the border and back. Either:
#   * the train you are on stops here for >= <minutes> (scheduled stop time), or
#   * you get off here and leave >= <minutes> later (next vehicle, walk or bike).
